hero.title: Crop advisory and farmer support for Western Odisha
hero.subtitle: Krishi Saathi combines live weather data, crop-stage knowledge, and local market prices to give farmers clear, actionable advice — and flags financial risk early so agriculture officers can act in time.

features.weatherDesc: Real-time temperature, humidity, and rainfall data from Open-Meteo, mapped to your district's seasonal normals.
features.advisoryDesc: Simple, practical recommendations based on your crop, its growth stage, current weather, and soil conditions — in your language.
features.marketDesc: See current modal prices across nearby markets and compare before you sell. Clearly marked as reference data, not live feeds.
features.riskDesc: An explainable score based on rainfall deviation, market price movement, and loan due dates — so high-risk farmers are never overlooked.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Enter your village, crop, sowing date, and farm size. Takes under a minute.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Weather-aware, crop-specific advice appears on your dashboard each day.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Compare mandi prices nearby before deciding where and when to sell.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Rainfall shocks, price drops, and loan deadlines are scored and flagged — no action needed from you.

footer.disclaimer: Krishi Saathi is a prototype decision-support tool for agricultural use. It does not provide medical or psychological diagnosis. Government scheme eligibility must be verified with the relevant department.
footer.dataNote: Market prices are dataset-based reference values sourced from AGMARKNET, not live feeds. Weather data is provided by Open-Meteo.

weather.cropImpact: What this means for your crop
weather.irrigationAttention: Rainfall is low. If irrigation is available, consider watering your field within the next two days.
weather.drainageAttention: Heavy rain is expected. Avoid irrigation and check that field drainage is clear.
weather.heatStress: High temperatures may stress your crop. Monitor soil moisture and irrigate if possible.
weather.error: Weather data is not available right now. Showing cached data from the last update.
